li.label: reached a goal
li.description: Something I wanted for a long time has happened. For once, in here, it went my way.

li.label: a setback on a goal
li.description: The one thing I was working toward just slipped away. All that effort, for this.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: make parole
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Wants to be out. They need to have served half the sentence, kept a clean sheet, passed programs and kept calm before a hearing. A hearing that goes badly is a setback and they aim for the next one; a third refusal ends it. On track, they steer clear of serious trouble.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: get clean
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Wants to be off the drugs. The addiction has to fade (supervised detox with a doctor on site, or a treatment program, is far quicker than waiting it out). A relapse or an overdose is a setback and they start again, twice at most. On track, they steer clear of serious trouble.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: earn a diploma
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Wants a certificate to take outside: they need to pass the next education program (foundation, then general education). It needs a classroom, a teacher and a seat in the class. A failed exam is a setback and they try once more. On track, they steer clear of serious trouble.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: stay in touch with family
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Wants to keep somebody at home close: letters that reach them and visits from the family count. It needs a mailroom and visiting hours to work. If that person cuts them off (a partner leaving) or dies, the goal is over and the anger may turn into a grudge. A new baby in the family makes it a goal about the child. On track, they steer clear of serious trouble.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: settle a score
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Holds a grudge against a particular member of staff (a memory of -60 or worse) or an enemy inside. Their outbursts go for that person, and they are readier to lash out at them than at anyone else. A blow that lands on them settles it (an insult does not); if the grudge cools or the window passes, they let it go.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: prove the board wrong
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Was turned down at a parole hearing and wants to show the board it was wrong: their odds there have to improve by a fair margin (a clean sheet, a program, work, a calmer head) and stay clean. A serious incident on the record ends it; if the window passes they let it go. Proving it earns a better hearing next time.

RimPrison.InmateWantDef.label: make amends
RimPrison.InmateWantDef.description: Inside for a violent crime, they want to face the family of the one they hurt. The goal is enough for the counsellor to propose a restorative meeting (without it, a program passed is needed); the warden approves it, and the family comes to the visitation room. A meeting that goes well reaches it; one that goes badly ends it; a refusal is a setback, and they ask once more.
